title: Decision made
description: One decision of an enforcement point (sections 6 and 8). A denied agent.stop never keeps the agent from stopping: that action is evaluated for the evidence only (section 6.3).

reason.description: Why the decision was taken (section 6.6). Never gate.evidence_full: a denial with it is the one decision not recorded, since the evidence buffer cannot take it (EP-8).

resource.description: What the action applies to (section 6.3). A tool's or a model's ID is its key in the catalog, or, for tooling that the catalog does not list, its name as the agent sees it, with reference_sha256 (section 8.3). A resource ID that is empty or longer than 512 characters, which makes the request invalid, or that has a lone surrogate, is recorded as the SHA-256 of its UTF-8 bytes, in id_sha256 rather than id (section 8.3).

id_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the resource ID's UTF-8 bytes, in lowercase hexadecimal, recorded in place of an ID that is empty or longer than 512 characters, or that has a lone surrogate, which an event cannot write: such an ID is hashed with each lone surrogate replaced by U+FFFD (section 8.3).

environment.description: The environment that the enforcement point's registration returned (I-7). Required with the reasons of a decision that evaluated policies: policy.permit, policy.forbid, policy.no_permit, error.evaluation and error.timeout. A decision taken before a registration returned one carries none.

policies.description: White Tower policy IDs that determined the decision.

bundle_version.description: The version of the bundle that decided (section 6.6): always with policy.permit, policy.forbid, policy.no_permit, error.evaluation and the reasons of the catalog check, never with the gate's reasons, and optional with error.timeout, error.unknown_agent and error.invalid_request.

origin.description: Who runs the tool, for a tool resource: the agent, or its model provider (section 4.10).

rules.description: The usage rules that decided, each by its policy's ID and its rule's ID, as the @rule annotations of the forbidding statements give them (section 6.11). Only with policy.forbid.

rule_id.description: The rule's ID, unique within its policy.

reference_sha256.description: For a tool or a model that the catalog does not list: the SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of the string form of its reference, in lowercase hexadecimal (sections 4.10 and 8.3). The resource's ID is then its name as the agent sees it.

block_id.description: The ID of the block that denied, with catalog.blocked only (EP-16).

evaluation_us.description: Time spent deciding, gate included, in microseconds.

arguments.description: What the enforcement point records about the call's arguments, as configured (section 8.3): their names, or, in the hashed mode, an HMAC with its key's ID. Never their values.

names.description: The arguments' names, each of at most 128 characters.

names_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of each argument name longer than 128 characters, or with a lone surrogate, which an event cannot write, in lowercase hexadecimal, recorded in place of the name. A name with a lone surrogate is hashed with each lone surrogate replaced by U+FFFD (section 8.3).

hmac_sha256.description: The hashed mode: the HMAC-SHA-256, in lowercase hexadecimal, of the canonical JSON of the arguments object as the tool receives it, with the deployment's key that key_id names. The canonical JSON is that of section 4.10, which writes integers exactly, whatever their size. Arguments without one, because of a number with a fraction or an exponent that is not finite as a double, a member name that repeats or a string with a lone surrogate, are recorded by their names alone, each once (section 8.3).

key_id.description: The ID of the deployment's key that computed hmac_sha256.
